item.title: ViewSet and Serializer in restframework
item.description: 1. View Class in Django First, recall how Django handles a request. After receiving a request, Django creates a handler of type WSGIHandler, and the handler controls the entire processing flow. So how are the request URL and the View associated with each other? Django first loads the URLconf according to the ROOT_URLCONF setting, then matches the URLpatterns in the URLconf one by one in order, stopping as soon as a match is found.
